rationale: The interpreter correctly captured the required behavior but left four open ambiguities that block a complete implementation. Each ambiguity must be resolved before the specification can be considered complete.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify the units for circuit heights and DX coil height.
findings.action: Clarify the height units (e.g., inches, centimeters) with the ticket owner.

findings.description: The ticket does not define valid height ranges or required precision for circuit heights.
findings.action: Obtain the acceptable range (minimum/maximum) and precision (number of decimal places) for circuit heights.

sourceRefs.quote: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.

findings.description: The ticket does not indicate the source or format of the initial circuit height values.
findings.action: Clarify how the starting circuit heights are provided (e.g., default values, data import) and their data format.

sourceRefs.quote: The source and format of starting circuit values are unspecified.

findings.description: The ticket does not define the behavior when circuits are added to or removed from the cooling package.
findings.action: Specify how the system should handle addition or removal of circuits and how the DX coil height should be recalculated.

sourceRefs.quote: Behavior when circuits are added or removed is unspecified.
